name: Fragment's Note 2 Side: Yukitsuki
source:
The Fragment's Note visual novel series returns with a brand new entry!
Fragment's Note 2 features the deeply moving stories of two new heroines!

Fragment's Note 2 is a slice-of-life visual novel/dating sim featuring Kyoichi Akikawa, a boy who lost his family in an airplane accident, the heroines close to him, and the story that binds them together.

[Taken from [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/fragments-note-2/id1107571023?mt=8]iTunes[/url]]
translation:
碎片笔记视觉小说系列带着全新作品回归！
Fragment's Note 2讲述了两位新女主人公的感人故事！

Fragment's Note 2是一款生活片段视觉小说/约会模拟游戏，讲述了在飞机事故中失去家人的男孩秋川恭一、他身边的女主角以及将他们联系在一起的故事。

[摘自[url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/fragments-note-2/id1107571023?mt=8]iTunes[/url]]
